Without a rate floor the fixed-horizon uniform minimax squared error is A²/4. Even unbounded random stopping cannot uniformly certify permanence at finite time more often than its allowed false-solid probability. A conventional one-sided mixture confidence sequence under a step does give upper bounds on g converging pointwise, eventually certifying any positive tolerance gamma>g on the coverage event without a uniform duration.
